caption: The drawing depicts a painted sculpture of a standing male figure set upon a rectangular wooden base. The figure is wearing a brown conical hat and has a black beard. The face is rendered in light brown with black hair, a prominent nose, and almond-shaped eyes outlined in black. The upper garment is red with white sections and black at the shoulders and chest, while the left shoulder is draped in a green wrap that hangs down and forms part of the long brown robe covering the lower half of the figure. The green wrap has a blue edge. The right hand is raised and partially closed as if holding something, and the left hand is open and extended forward. On the right side of the drawing, there is a separate close-up illustration of the figure’s head and upper chest, set against a pale turquoise rectangular background. The drawing is done on a plain off-white background, and the artist's name and location ("Marjorie G. Caffey – Taos, N.M.") are written below the close-up.
title: San Jose, Carved and Painted Wooden Santo
